notes.author: David Revoy <https://framagit.org/Deevad>
text: After a long time, here is episode 28, the second part of the trilogy about the Coronation of Coriander. This one took me a long time to produce (thank you for your patience) and believe me, I've been working on it full time since half November 2018.

In real life, I'm not someone to be very active at parties and I like the bench, sitting in the dark, outside, hearing the music and people having fun from a distance. I probably spent a lot of time thinking this way during parties. That's a place I like and I hope those who also like these moments will recognize that in this episode. This episode resolves all the jealousy Pepper had about her friends and brings more story background in a subtle way; we meet Shichimi's school (with the first appearance of Wasabi, her master, a character I want to reuse later), it gives a glimpse of what Coriander will have to manage, and also introduces the new personality of Saffron-as-a-superstar. This episode also erases the last bit of shame Pepper had about her own magic family. Pepper really evolved a lot and now she is ready to be a powerful witch of Chaosah. :) I like it when the conclusion of a story happens not after a fight, but when characters just change their point of view.
I hope you liked this episode 28; now let's get started with the production of ep29! Thanks again to all translators, contributors and patrons to let me draw Pepper&Carrot!
